result.rationale: Retain one active project-level portfolio company but correct its identity to CZ Solar Warren, LLC. Harrison Street acquired the 28 MW Cincinnati Zoo Solar project from Soltage in September 2022 through its Social Infrastructure Strategy. Public evidence does not identify a specific Harrison Street fund, upstream vehicle or ownership percentage, so those fields remain undisclosed. Current Cincinnati Zoo evidence supports operating status and no later sale or signed pending exit was found.

evidence.purpose: Official buyer evidence for acquisition, strategy, seller, capacity and project structure.
Official manager evidence for the September 2022 close and Cincinnati Zoo Solar identity.
Seller-side evidence for the Melink-to-Soltage development chain and PPAs.
Regulatory evidence for the CZ Solar Warren project-company identity.
SEC evidence distinguishing Nelnet tax-equity vehicles from manager-level ownership.
Current landowner evidence for operating status, Harrison Street continuity and Bowyer Farm location.
